**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's rook guards the second rank, sacrificing a pawn to pull the king out of safety can win material. Here, fxg2+ forces the rook to recapture, then Qxh3+ wins the hanging h-pawn with check. Look for checks that expose or trap your opponent's king—they often force favorable sequences.
